title: Edmund and the Thorn
author: Quentin Pemberton
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
